title: Tenant Operating System Studio Convergence Contracts

phases.objective: Provide repository-native convergence contracts for package/install semantics, canonical authority ownership, exact-current-main reuse evidence, Draft portfolio evidence, and decision-ready T006 identity/cutover proposals without granting runtime mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run Spec015 contract, canonical authority, live-delta, and Tenant audit validators from the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Manifest inventory, semantic ontology, current-main field-level reuse at 0faee775cd0572b737fed8bc74e2580d9fca2878, seven T006 decision candidates, historical portfolio evidence, Work Map, completion truthfulness, and no-secret boundaries pass while T006/T008 approval and all runtime implementation remain blocked.
steps: Validate exact manifest inventory and specification-only boundaries.
Validate the 30 canonical concepts and prohibit authority inference from Tool, Package, Agent, Skill, Installation Revision, Execution Capsule, Effective Runtime Manifest, or projection visibility.
Validate current-main field mappings for package/component/install/capability/operation/tool/agent/skill/workflow/activity-pack/MCP/manifest/legacy-action semantics.
Validate T002/T003 evidence completion without persistence or runtime claims.
Validate the T006 decision register has seven decisions, approval_status=pending_owner_review and cutover_executed=false.
Validate legacy actions as Provider Capability Group semantics, endpoints as provider operation contracts, and Business Action as a separate product/domain semantic.
Validate canonical_capabilities as the target semantic identity domain while global runtime cutover remains blocked on shadow parity and rollback proof.
Validate historical 34-PR base and append-only 35-PR live-delta portfolio evidence independently from the newer authority inventory.
Validate Work Map/completion state and scan the Spec directory for prohibited secret patterns.
assertions: No new solution_package_* persistence is approved by inventory evidence.
Current package/version/install authorities are mandatory reuse inputs before Phase 1 persistence decisions.
T006 is decision-ready but not complete; no physical table rename, capability cutover, candidate merge, or runtime route switch occurs.
Specification completion is not runtime, migration, provider, deployment, or Production completion.
MCP remains transport/tool projection and cannot create independent execution authority.

phases.objective: Implement Package/Component foundation and deterministic installation compilation by extending or bridging current-main authorities before adding higher product layers.
blockers: T006 owner approval is pending for semantic identities and cutover targets.
T008 owner approval is pending for package authority extension, component gaps, installation revision, security/privacy/product/external boundaries.
Package publication semantics are not approved.
Generic Component identity/dependency persistence is not approved.
Immutable Installation Revision and typed requirement-binding persistence are not approved.
Custom entity persistence is not approved.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Tenant system designer and package reviewer
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Create and compile a private tenant package through approved extensions of current package/version/install authorities
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The package validates, installs for one exact Brand in sandbox, produces a deterministic immutable installation revision, and exposes tenant-safe surfaces without implicit authority.
steps: Reuse or extend platform package/version/install authorities instead of creating parallel truth.
Reference canonical Agent/Skill/Workflow/Policy/Activity Pack assets rather than copying them into generic components.
Compile exact scope and typed requirement bindings with lineage, revision vector and deterministic hash.
Prove UI/MCP/resource/operation authority remains server-enforced.

phases.objective: Prove upgrades, rollback, provider/manual fallback, backup/restore, delegation revocation, export and handover continuity.
blockers: Operational package/install runtime is not implemented.
Reference packages and agency/client/external journeys are not reconstructed.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Upgrade an installation with local overrides and revoke delegated/external access
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Conflicts are explicit, rollback is verified, access is revoked, and client-owned operation continues.
steps: Run three-way package upgrade.
Exercise fallback/restore/rollback.
Revoke and hand over dependencies with denial readback.

phases.objective: Run bounded freelancer, agency/client, reference-package including Content Intelligence, and read-only MCP cohorts.

planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Isolation, health/cost, fallback, rollback, revocation and handover readiness are proven.
steps: Pilot freelancer and two isolated agency client Brands.
Pilot client-owned Tenant delegation/revocation.
Run approved reference packages only after foundation certification.
Verify read-only MCP scoped discovery/denial/disable/revocation.

blockers: Canary acceptance and Production authority absent.
